---
title: "GIAB Data Portal (MVP)"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
exists_csv <- function(x) file.exists(x)
fastq <- if (exists_csv("data/derived/fastq.csv")) readr::read_csv("data/derived/fastq.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
bam   <- if (exists_csv("data/derived/bam.csv"))   readr::read_csv("data/derived/bam.csv",   show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
vcf   <- if (exists_csv("data/derived/vcf.csv"))   readr::read_csv("data/derived/vcf.csv",   show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL

summary_tbl <- tibble(
  table = c("FASTQ","BAM","VCF"),
  rows  = c(nrow(fastq %||% tibble()), nrow(bam %||% tibble()), nrow(vcf %||% tibble()))
)
knitr::kable(summary_tbl)
```

This MVP site is built from data in data/derived/ produced by scripts in scripts/.
